- PO attached for internal tracking (acme_po_12345.pdf)

Why: they are evaluating for a Q2 pilot; engineering is already poking at latency and token cost concerns. A short credit to run ~100k tokens worth of tests should surface any regressions quickly.

If we can issue a code today I’ll email Emily with instructions + onboarding offer (quick 30-min call).

Thanks,

Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Your Redwood trial credits — ready to use

Hi Emily — congrats on getting signed up!

We’ve issued a $1,000 trial credit for Acme Finance to help your team run initial evaluations. You can redeem the credit directly here: https://app.redwood.com/credits/redeem/ACME-TRIAL-1000

Quick tips to get started:
- Run a short embedding pass on a representative 10–20k row sample to validate recall vs cost.
- Use the embedding async batch endpoint for cheaper throughput.
- For chat flows, start with a 512-token context and run a 1k-token worst-case test to estimate costs.

If you’d like, we can set up a 30-minute technical walkthrough this week to help your engineers optimize batch size and caching — I can do Wed/Thu afternoon PT.

Let me know if you prefer the code applied to a specific org or workspace.

Best,
Marissa

From: Emily Jones <emily.jones@acmefinance.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 09:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Your Redwood trial credits — ready to use

Hi Marissa — thanks for sending the code. I wanted to flag that our team redeemed the credit but we’re seeing very low activation — only two engineers have run small smoke tests and we haven’t seen meaningful throughput. A few blockers:
- Our infra folks are cautious about prod-like traffic hitting our VPC without a quick runbook;
- We got tripped on the auth workflow and needed a short-time user onboarding script;

Is it possible to extend the expiration by 14 days? If we can get a short 30-minute ramp call with an engineer from your side that would help us push to a broader cohort and surface any infra questions.

Thanks,
Emily Jones
Senior Product Manager, Acme Finance
emily.jones@acmefinance.com

Hi Emily — thanks for the update and totally understand the friction. We can extend the trial window by 14 days and schedule the call to get your infra team comfortable.

What I’ll do now:
- Ask ops to extend ACME-TRIAL-1000 expiry by 14 days (Tessa, can you confirm when done?)
- Book a 30-min onboarding call this Wed/Thu — please share a couple times that work for your infra/eng lead
- Share a one-page runbook for safe testing (auth checklist + sample request patterns) before broad ramp

Thanks — looking forward to getting your team going.
